<function name="DisableWorldClicking" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Disables world clicking for given player. See <page>Panel:SetWorldClicker</page> and <page>Player:IsWorldClickingDisabled</page>.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2023.01.25</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="disable" type="boolean">Whether the world clicking should be disabled.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
